ideas.pitch: An AI-powered preventive healthcare diagnostics platform that analyzes multi-spectral skin and nail images to detect early signs of nutritional deficiencies and metabolic disorders.
ideas.title: AuraScan AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Healthcare and Well being track by solving early preventive screening, aligning with the pattern of clear measurable health impact seen in winning nutrition and patient acquisition apps.

ideas.pitch: A smart agriculture supply chain platform that matches agricultural waste producers with local circular economy biomass processors using spatial route optimization.
ideas.title: AgriCirculate
ideas.why_it_could_win: Wins the Sustainability and ClimateTech track by targeting waste management and circular economy with a concrete, quantifiable environmental benefit.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven accessibility and campus solutions tool that generates real-time audio-visual navigation guides and study material adaptations for students with visual and hearing impairments.
ideas.title: CampusLoop
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the Education Technology track's emphasis on accessibility and campus solutions by solving a familiar pain point for students and evaluators on academic campuses.

ideas.pitch: An EV charging infrastructure load-forecasting dashboard that uses time-series modeling to predict grid strain and dynamically optimize local micro-grid power distribution.
ideas.title: VoltTrace EV
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the Sustainability and ClimateTech track by applying rigorous time-series forecasting techniques directly analogous to winning AI prediction platforms.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered triage and workflow assistant for mental health clinics that matches patient journal logs with evidence-based therapeutic modules while ensuring strict privacy compliance.
ideas.title: MindPath AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the mental health subcategory of the Healthcare and Well being track, scoring high on practical utility for clinical workflows and vulnerable populations.
